comment: The German of Cartouche's App Intents (launcher/Sources/CartoucheShortcuts.swift), as fr.json is their French: app/scripts/app_intents.py writes strings into the app's de.lproj/Localizable.strings and phrases into its AppShortcuts.strings. Each key is the English as the intents give it, a phrase with its game as ${game} and Cartouche's name as ${applicationName}, which every phrase holds, as Siri needs it. The build stops when a title or a phrase of the intents has no German here (app/tests/test_app_intents.py checks it on Linux too).

strings.Opens Cartouche and starts one of your g: Öffnet Cartouche und startet eines deiner Spiele, wie Spielen.
